name: Villar del Pozo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and yellow, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villar del Pozo (a Maltese cross and a well).
history: Municipal flag of Villar del Pozo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villar del Pozo arms — Maltese cross and well
